name: youtube-video-player

frames.best_why: Frame 1 shows the cover, title, play button and expand control together before playback.

tagline: Cover image with a play button opens the clip large.
summary: A rounded 16:9 video card showing a poster, a centred play button and the title. Pressing play swaps in an autoplaying YouTube embed, and the corner expand button blows it up over a dimmed page.
appearance: A rounded 16:9 card filled with the Big Buck Bunny cover, a large circular play button with a dark triangle in the middle, the title just below it, and a small round expand icon at the top right. Once playing it becomes the YouTube embed with its own header and controls.
behaviour: Clicking play replaces the poster with an autoplaying YouTube iframe. The expand button grows the card into a centred overlay over a blurred dark backdrop and its icon flips to minimise; Escape closes the overlay.
demo_content: Big Buck Bunny cover and title; the embed plays Big Buck Bunny 60fps 4K.
search_phrases: video card with a play button
youtube embed that opens in a lightbox
expand video to full screen overlay
watch a youtube clip in a modal
movie thumbnail with centered play icon
use_when: You have a YouTube clip and want a poster card that opens it large, in-page, without leaving the layout.
avoid_when: You need self-hosted or offline media: playback depends on YouTube and its iframe.
customise: videoId and customThumbnail set the clip and poster, title sets the caption, and about a dozen className props restyle each part. Behaviour is fixed.
weight_why: One image and a layout animation; the YouTube iframe only loads after play.

a11y.note: The dimmed backdrop is a clickable div with only an aria-label and no button role, so keyboard users can close it just with Escape.

issues: Frames 2 and 3 show the card as a blank dark rectangle before the video loads.
The expand backdrop is a div with no button role, so keyboard users can only close it with Escape.
polish_why: Tidy cover card, but the playing state inherits YouTube's chrome and two frames render blank.
